description: Creates a thought type or a tag: the vocabulary thoughts are classified with, which brain_create_thought cannot make. Call it when brain_list_types_and_tags has none that fits. Under the name of a tag the brain has, in any letter case, no second tag is made and the result gives that one. A type is made even when another has the name.

brainId.description: Brain identifier. Take it from brain_list — never guess it.

kind.description: A type is what typeId takes; a tag is what brain_tag and tagIds take.

name.description: Its name, as TheBrain will show it.

name: brain_create_type_or_tag
